rules.conflictResolution: resolve against ecosystem-policy.json and canonical source-of-truth

audits.scope: public web, press and public social posts
qualified executive portrait lead conversion and Proof-of-Concept guardrails
audits.rule: Risk reversal must remain selective, privacy-safe, evidence-safe, commercially bounded and must never become an automatic free-service entitlement.

audits.scope: executive brand photography and visual positioning across person, seniority, generational context, role, professional field, stakeholder audience, channels and market culture
audits.rule: Executive visual positioning must be individualized and context-aware. Generation may inform communication context but must never become a demographic stereotype or a standalone styling rule.

audits.scope: BANHALMI Photography × VIPACH Flickr profile and downstream relationship pointers
audits.rule: The Flickr profile is the official shared event and community photography gallery of BANHALMI Photography and VIPACH. It is an external evidence surface, not a Layer-1 canonical property, and must preserve team-level authorship and relationship boundaries.

dailyBalanceReview.rule: A technically healthy layer may still be flagged when it materially lags the other canonical layers in authority, evidence or discoverability.
